Total career_development_score total_query = "SELECT SUM(career_development_score) as total_score FROM workday__employee_overview;" total_score = pd.read_sql(total_query, conn).iloc[0,0] print(f"\nTotal career_development_score: {total_score}") # 2. Group by compensation_grade_id with counts and sums group_query = """ SELECT compensation_grade_id, COUNT(*) as employee_count, SUM(career_development_score) as group_score FROM workday__employee_overview GROUP BY compensation_grade_id ORDER BY employee_count DESC; """ group_data = pd.read_sql(group_query, conn) print("\nGrouped data by compensation_grade_id:") print(group_data) # 3. Progressive exclusion calculation # Sort groups by employee_count descending group_data = group_data.sort_values('employee_count', ascending=False) # Initialize results running_total = total_score results = [] # Progressive exclusions for _, row in group_data.iterrows(): group_score = row['group_score'] group_count = row['employee_count'] # Calculate running total after exclusion running_total -= group_score # Calculate implicit per-group totals via subtraction implicit_total = total_score - running_total results.append({ 'compensation_grade_id': row['compensation_grade_id'], 'employee_count': group_count, 'group_score': group_score, 'running_total': running_total, 'implicit_total': implicit_total }) # Create results DataFrame results_df = pd.DataFrame(results) print("\nProgressive exclusion results:") print(results_df) # Identify residual value residual = results_df.iloc[-1]['running_total'] print(f"\nResidual value after all exclusions: {residual}") # Save
